purpose: Project the final LBE product plan as one persistent provider-neutral governed agent lifecycle. UI, guard packs, Cline mechanics, external integrations and historical clients are subordinate capabilities or projections, not separate product architectures.
authority_rule: Before every project decision or next-step instruction, refresh this GPT-K plan/status/handoff first, then inspect current canonical local source/runtime/governance evidence. GPT-K is project context/projection; local current evidence remains implementation truth. Chat-history JSON is memory only.
final_product_goal: A local persistent LBE agent that can start or resume a workspace/session, reason with a selected provider, discover and request governed capabilities, execute only through LBE authorization and registered adapters, consume ToolReceipts/evidence, replan across turns, deterministically validate completion, persist/recover state, and expose the same lifecycle through whichever existing client surface reaches correct manual acceptance fastest without creating a second authority.
core_invariant: Agent/provider owns cognition; LBE owns capabilities and consequences.

lifecycle_plan.required_product_behavior: Resolve canonical workspace, persisted session, provider/model/profile, mode/policy and installed capabilities; create or restore exactly one product session.
Assemble bounded current workspace/project context and evidence without replacing agent reasoning with a fixed LBE cognitive workflow.
Agent independently chooses investigation strategy, capabilities and next actions; structured ReasoningPlan remains optional/specialist rather than mandatory product cognition.

Every authority-bearing capability request passes through existing policy/R6C authorization and R6E ToolRegistry/GovernedToolOrchestrator; execution returns one correlated ToolReceipt/evidence record.
Registered evidence producers and deterministic completion owners evaluate outcome; provider prose cannot establish terminal completion truth.
Persist session/task state, runtime events, receipts, evidence, recovery/checkpoint state and only evidence-gated validated memory/completion truth.
Agent consumes receipts/evidence, replans or completes; LBE preserves identity, authority boundaries, cancellation/recovery and resume across turns/restarts.

capability_model.workspace_tools: Registered read/mutation/process/Git capabilities execute only through LBE governance.
capability_model.external_integrations: MCP/plugin/subagent/network/hosted services materialize only as preconfigured governed registrations; provider sees schemas, never raw transport authority.
capability_model.guards: Project profile selects approved guard catalog; guards remain deterministic bounded capabilities, not the agent reasoning engine.
capability_model.provider_runtime: Provider/Cline continuation mechanics may be reused behind LBE authority; no provider-native mutation/session/completion authority.
capability_model.memory: Historical/context/validated memory supports reasoning and persistence but does not override current workspace/runtime truth.

product_surface_plan.final_target: UI implementation is delivery-flexible; current selected executable client is the existing Rust/Ratatui LetterBlack TUI because it is the most complete working client and is already attached to canonical LBE. HTML and copied Cline/OpenTUI remain visual/mechanics references, not mandatory product frameworks.
product_surface_plan.selection_basis: Reuse the most complete existing surface and do not let UI framework choice block runtime/product completion.
product_surface_plan.projection_rule: Conversation surfaces project agent/provider reasoning; workspace/evidence/execution/receipt/validation/history surfaces project LBE-owned truth. The client must not own session persistence, authorization, execution, receipts/evidence, or completion truth.
product_surface_plan.current_truth: Rust real LBE attachment, authoritative workspace/session projection, workspace receipt/evidence projection, interactive SubmitTask dispatch, canonical turn creation, persisted event return, Rust projection of the returned turn state, and clean quit are proven in current local evidence. Successful provider completion is blocked by ProviderError [WinError 10061].
product_surface_plan.historical_surfaces: Python/Textual was removed. HTML cockpit remains a visual/product reference. Copied Cline/OpenTUI remains mechanics/reference only. None may create a competing runtime authority.
